_comment_caps: Playwright MCP runs with --caps=core (no-vision): the accessibility tree + ref= ids drive selection, never screenshot coordinates. This keeps authoring/heal token cost down. Enable --caps=vision ONLY per-session, by hand, for genuine canvas/WebGL pages that expose an empty a11y tree — never commit it here. See .cursor/rules/snapshot-first-authoring.mdc.
